title: Gone Awrye
description: Adds a twisted new grain to the Nether
body:
[![Latest Release](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/v/E6zxHuwX?style=for-the-badge&label=Latest%20Release&color=aaaaaa)](https://modrinth.com/mod/wordstones/version/latest) [![Requires Fabric API](https://img.shields.io/badge/requires-fabric_api-aaaaaa?style=for-the-badge)](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) [![Compatible with Sinytra Connector](https://img.shields.io/badge/compatible-sinytra_connector-aaaaaa?style=for-the-badge)](https://modrinth.com/mod/connector) # About **Gone Awrye** is a small mod that adds a new crop to the Nether called Rye, as well as a few brewing recipes > ⚠️ Warning
> This project is still in development, expect breaking updates and bugs # Features - **Rye** is a new crop found in the Nether, that grows on the bottom side of Soul Soil - **Brews** are a new type of potion that give otherwise hard to obtain status effects # License This project is licensed under [LGPL 3.0](https://www.gnu.org/licenses/lgpl-3.0.en.html) You are free to include this project in your modpacks
